name: Exa
summary: Neural web search and page reading.
description: Exa's remote MCP server gives the agent a search built for meaning rather than keywords, plus page extraction. It needs an API key, which bounds cost and access; store it in the credential vault.

probe.note: Answers 405 with a JSON-RPC error on GET and sends no WWW-Authenticate header; the key is carried in the request as documented by Exa.
